highlights: Fare arithmetic error on an overnight trip: lines ₹39,000, Grand Total ₹37,000 (OUT-09-Issue-01).
Edit Inquiry cannot be saved ('"email" is not allowed to be empty field'); locations are read-only (OUT-18).
Modify Inquiry pre-fill switches toggles ON / moves destination into Drop, and can reset the drop date (OUT-04).
Above 49 passengers a second vehicle replaces the first (recurrence of Local TC-04-Issue-01).
Map follows add/delete/change except after removing extra destination fields (stale marker).
Double-click submit created exactly one inquiry; dates across month/year render correctly; per-km consistency ₹55/km.

issues.title: Estimated Grand Total does not equal the sum of its lines for an overnight trip (₹39,000 shown as ₹37,000)
issues.where: Results → Book This Vehicle → Confirm Your Trip & Selected Vehicles → Estimated Trip Cost
steps: Log in to User App Preprod (Personal Login → Mobile Number).
Home → Smart Inquiry → Outstation.
Pickup Sarjapur Road, First Destination Kolar, Different drop OFF.
Pickup 17 Dec 2026 11:30 PM, Drop 18 Dec 2026 4:00 AM, Passengers 25 → Book Now!.
Book This Vehicle on 40 Seater Deluxe Coach (D40NA); read Estimated Trip Cost.
issues.expected: Estimated Grand Total = Vehicle Base Cost + Day Bata + Night Bata + State Tax = ₹36,000 + ₹2,000 + ₹1,000 + ₹0 = ₹39,000.
issues.actual: Lines: Base ₹36,000, Day Bata ₹2,000, Night Bata ₹1,000, State Tax ₹0; Estimated Grand Total ₹37,000 (₹2,000 lower). Reproduced twice. All other Confirm screens in this run add up correctly.
issues.impact: Customer sees an inconsistent quote; either a line or the total is wrong for trips crossing midnight.

scope: Executed: all 18 Outstation use cases of the v3.1 workbook; results graded per case (Pass/Fail/Partial/Inconclusive).
Fare verdicts follow .claude/shared/fare-verification.md; amounts that depend on unconfirmed rules are 'Inconclusive', never assumed.
OUT-15 step 2 (Admin-Web no-availability) not executed – conditional on approval. Zero-match filter state could not be reached.
OUT-18: Edit 1 (destinations/drop) and the pickup change are impossible in the UI; invalid edit was never saved.
Modify-based steps (OUT-04, OUT-14) corrected the faulty pre-fill before Save! so the documented scenario could continue.
Environment notes: Preprod logged the session out once and the test browser was stopped by low memory twice; affected cases were rerun.
Tool notes: card CTA changes to 'Send Inquiry' after Modify and cards hide the vehicle code on hover – handled in the automation.
Transfer use cases not executed. Local report untouched.
